aboutSection.heading: Hi, I'm Ryan.
aboutSection.lede: I'm a mechanical engineer in Boston, focused on clean energy and aerospace. I love designing equipment that real people use on the floor — and watching it cut hours off a shift.
aboutSection.bio:
I'm currently a Manufacturing Engineering Co-op at Commonwealth Fusion Systems, where I support the poloidal field magnets for the SPARC tokamak. Previously I was an Operations Engineering Co-op at Raytheon Missiles & Defense in Andover, working on circuit card production for missile and radar systems. I also lead the propulsion sub-team at Northeastern's Aerospace Club, and I'm the mechanical design lead on my senior capstone — a low-cost underwater acoustic release for ropeless fishing gear.

I gravitate toward designs that improve safety and ergonomics for the people who use them. The best mechanical engineering, to me, is invisible — it makes someone's job easier without them ever having to think about it.

items.title: Running
items.body: I love running! I'm President of Northeastern's Running Club. I've recently broken into longer distances. I've run a trail 50k and placed 800th overall at the Boston Marathon in 2026.

items.title: Music
items.body: I have a great appreciation for music. I played trumpet in high school, picked up guitar my junior year, and now play rhythm guitar in an alt-rock band.

items.title: Interior Design & Plants
items.body: I have always had an appreciation for small details, and I bring that into the spaces I live in. I also love flowers and plants!

contactSection.heading: We should talk!
contactSection.body: I'm always up for chatting about clean energy, aerospace, manufacturing, or design. Drop me a line — I read everything.
